summary: Former lookout on the Adams/Wood county line, listed as gone; a 1970 report of a company tower there apparently blown down. Identity with this record unconfirmed.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. A November 1970 newspaper report describes a company lookout near the Wood-Adams county line as apparently blown down, but no source ties that report to this record.

events.note: Unconfirmed: a 1970 report describes a company lookout near the Wood-Adams County line as apparently blown down; it names Nekoosa-Edwards Paper Co. as owner. No source ties it to this record.

notes_for_editor: Identity unresolved. The 1970 report describes a company lookout near the Wood-Adams county line, which fits the Nekoosa (County Line) point, but the Association also lists Nursery (Nepco Lake) in Wood County as gone, and the report names neither record. The story says so. The Nepco page is a fan history that quotes newspaper items; its 1928 item concerns a tower in Ashland and Sawyer counties and is not used. The report's 60-foot height, owner and staffing are not in facts because the record is unconfirmed; the blown-down report is kept only as an 'other' event with that caveat. No build date, design or present-day site record found. Mapcarta gives Adams County; the Association gives Adams/Wood.
